_meta.description: Tenant-level controlled vocabularies for Kestrel Systems. Competitors are a closed list (new names become review candidates); pain themes are a seeded taxonomy the extractor classifies into.

product: Kestrel QMS (quality-management SaaS for food and packaging manufacturers)

pain_themes.label: Audit-prep effort
pain_themes.description: Time and people lost preparing for certification audits (BRCGS, IFS, FSSC), e.g. chasing supplier certificates.

pain_themes.label: CAPA backlog
pain_themes.description: Corrective and preventive actions that are overdue, untracked or escalated by auditors.

pain_themes.label: Fragmented tools
pain_themes.description: Quality data spread over spreadsheets, SharePoint and several systems, with no single source of truth.

pain_themes.label: No cross-site visibility
pain_themes.description: Managers cannot compare or see quality performance across plants or sites.

pain_themes.label: Failed or slow implementation
pain_themes.description: A previous quality tool took far longer than promised, was abandoned, or never integrated.
